combo_label: At the Supermarket × Photography × Norse Mythology

entries.clue: Icelandic compendium of god-lore, one in Snorri's prose and one in elder verse
World ash whose three roots drink from wells while a dragon gnaws below
Odin's spear, flung over a host to open the first war and sworn upon by gods
Anybody in the store to buy rather than to sell, however lost they look
Barrel of curved glass through which the world arrives upside down
One of three sisters at the well of fate, carving what must come for gods and men
Wide sweep of hills and sky, or the sideways way to hold a page
Warm brown tone that makes a fresh print look a century old
Crumpled film left in your pocket after the chocolate bar is gone
Black surface the car park is laid with, white bays painted over it
